outline: 1388 Mental Shortcuts for Adding and Subtracting Integers

examples.solution_text:
(a) Different signs give a negative answer.
$4\times7=28$
$(-4)\times7=-28$
(b) Same signs give a positive answer.
$4\times7=28$
$(-4)\times(-7)=28$

(a) Different signs give a negative answer.
$63\div9=7$
$(-63)\div9=-7$
(b) The fraction bar means division. The signs are the same, so the answer is positive.
$56\div8=7$
$\frac{-56}{-8}=7$

examples.question_text:
(a) Evaluate $36\div(-3)\times(-2)$.
(b) Find the missing number: $\square\times(-5)=45$. Check your answer.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Multiplication and division have equal priority, so work from left to right.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}36\div(-3)\times(-2)\\&=-12\times(-2)\\&=24\end{aligned}$
(b) Divide the product by the known factor.
$45\div(-5)=-9$
The missing number is $-9$.
Check: $(-9)\times(-5)=45$.
